column5: ,meaning,interpretation,beginner,What does Krishna say can help restrain the restless mind?,Lord Shri Krishna replied: Doubtless, O Mighty One, the mind is fickle and exceedingly difficult to restrain, but, O Son of Kunti, with practice and renunciation it can be done.","Practice and letting go of attachment can train the mind, even though it is difficult to control.",Only forcefully suppressing every thought can permanently remove distraction and quiet the mind completely.,"Meditation cannot help a restless person, so the practice should be abandoned for good right away.","To quiet the mind, a person must withdraw from ordinary responsibilities and relationships entirely.","Practice and letting go of attachment can train the mind, even though it is difficult to control.","Krishna acknowledges Arjuna's difficulty, then names practice and dispassion as the means of restraint.","Purohit Swami, BG6.35; original paraphrase",Retain both means—practice and dispassion—in the correct answer.
